balanced.rationale: medium (step-up) = threshold reaching 95% validation recall, but never flagging more than 4% of validation transactions; high (review / temporary hold recommendation) = lowest score where validation precision >= 90%

strict.rationale: medium (step-up) = threshold reaching 98% validation recall, but never flagging more than 6% of validation transactions; high (review / temporary hold recommendation) = lowest score where validation precision >= 75%

young_recipient.rationale: Opt-in: step-up threshold for transfers to accounts younger than 30 days, chosen on validation (lowest false-alarm rate with <= 2 pp loss of young-fraud recall). See experiments/results/fairness_young_recipient.json.
